title: 040 - Diagonal Sum
prompt: Fix the bug so the program sum the main diagonal and print 14 and prints exactly `14`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function diagonalSum(array $values): string
{
    sort($values);
    return implode(",", $values);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function diagonalSum(array $values): string
{
    rsort($values);
    return implode(",", $values);
}
hint: The program is summing the wrong diagonal.
explanation: The broken code uses the anti-diagonal indexes. Summing row i and column i fixes the total.
